brief.goal: Replace the n8n Docker sidecar with an in-app cron and service mechanism, eliminating Docker as a hard prerequisite.
brief.constraints: Electron 33 + React 19 + TypeScript 5.7 stack; Existing n8n Docker sidecar (compose, health, IPC handlers); Existing in-app CronScheduler already handles email fetch/classify; Existing GoogleTasksSync and TickTickSync already work without n8n; SQLite database (current schema version 19); Vitest 3 for testing; Zod validation on IPC payloads
nonGoals: Do NOT change the cron scheduling logic (email fetch/classify pipeline works)
Do NOT modify task sync algorithms (Google Tasks and TickTick sync are stable)
Do NOT implement new background services beyond formalizing existing ones
successCriteria: All background tasks run in-app without Docker
Cron schedules persist across app restarts
Service status visible in UI (replaces n8n health indicator)
Docker is no longer a hard prerequisite
Existing n8n users get graceful migration
No Docker processes spawned after migration
All existing tests continue to pass
